chunks: And it is narrated from al-Bazantī, who said:
I said to Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام: “May I be sacrificed for you, a man died and left behind his daughter and his paternal uncle.” So he said: “The wealth belongs to the daughter.”

He said: And I said to him, “A man died and left behind a daughter of his and a brother,” or he said, “his brother’s son.” He said: He remained silent for a long time, then said: “The wealth belongs to the daughter.”

key_terms.الْمَالُ لِلِابْنَةِ: the estate belongs to the daughter
key_terms.تَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ: left behind his daughter as an heir
key_terms.هَلَكَ: died; passed away, initiating the inheritance case

ai.seo_question: Who inherits when a deceased man leaves a daughter along with an uncle, brother, or nephew?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance, stating that when a deceased man leaves a daughter along with a paternal uncle, a brother, or a nephew through a brother, the estate belongs to the daughter. The narration addresses direct offspring inheritance and indicates the precedence of the daughter over these collateral male relatives.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5607 - It is narrated from Al-Bazanti who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far Al-Thani (as):
"May I be sacrificed for you! A man has died and left behind his daughter and his paternal uncle."
Imam (as) replied: "The entire wealth belongs to the daughter."

Al-Bazanti further said: I asked Imam (as), "A man has died and left behind his daughter and a (his) brother", or he said, "the son of his brother."
Imam (as) remained silent for a long time and said: "The entire wealth belongs to the daughter."
